scenes.text: What if you could split a single atom - with your bare hands?
scenes.art_prompt: a glowing single atom rendered as a bright nucleus ringed by orbiting electrons, dramatic macro view

scenes.text: It would not feel like power. It would feel like nothing.
scenes.art_prompt: an open human palm holding a tiny point of white light, dark background, tense

scenes.text: Then the energy inside that one atom would arrive all at once.
scenes.art_prompt: a blinding sphere of light expanding outward in slow motion, energy waves, cinematic

scenes.text: Enough to level a street. From something smaller than a grain of dust.
scenes.art_prompt: a shockwave of dust and light rolling through an empty city street, physics illustration

scenes.text:
That is why matter only looks solid.
It is almost entirely empty space, holding an enormous secret.
scenes.art_prompt: a cutaway diagram of an atom showing vast empty space around a dense core, science visual

scenes.text: Follow What If Physics for more.
scenes.art_prompt: a calm view of a single atom glowing softly against deep space, resolved conclusion
